A copper container of mass 0.20kg contains 0.10kg of water.
The specific heat capacity of copper is 385J/(kg°C) and the specific heat capacity of water
is 4200J/(kg°C).
How much energy, in joules, is needed to raise the temperature of the copper container and the
water by 10°C?
